name: FreedomIntelligence/EasyMED
what_it_is: A modular multi-agent virtual standardized patient framework for medical education, decomposing clinical history-taking into coordinated agents for patient simulation, intent recognition, and post-consultation evaluation.
measurement: ClinicalEvaluator structured scoring across history-taking, exams, diagnoses, treatment
constraints: Requires OpenAI-compatible LLM backend; no offline model
Case data must conform to JSON schema
notable_absences: No web UI or REST server
No fine-tuning or local model weights
